title: Named canonical tensor-pullback composition comparison
statement: For scheme morphisms $g:Z\to Y$, $h:Y\to X$, $k:Z\to X$ with $h\circ g=k$, let $P_a$ be tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and $a_*$ pushforward. Define $P_k\cong P_g\circ P_h$ as the conjugate under the canonical tensor adjunctions [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] of the pushforward isomorphism $h_*\circ g_*\cong k_*$, namely pushforward composition followed by congruence along the equality. This is the explicit comparison already used in lem-pc-fp-module-map-descent, now with a typed name.

source.place: Sheaves of Modules, Tags 0095 and 0096, pullback and its canonical adjunction

proof_origin.place: Tags 0095 and 0096; same conjugate formula as lem-pc-fp-module-map-descent

mathlib_searches.query: canonical composition isomorphism of pullback functors from conjugation of pushforward composition under adjunctions

mathlib_searches.results: Found CategoryTheory.conjugateIsoEquiv in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Mates and its hom/inv formulas; used this exact constructor in the definition. No named scheme tensor comparison.

from.place: Finite-presentation and differential data descent: canonical identification of successive pullbacks

def tensorPullbackCompositionIso
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ X) (k : Z ⟶ X) (w : g ≫ h = k) :
    tensorPullback k ≅ tensorPullback h ⋙ tensorPullback g
